ITEM 1 | Pale green crisp lettuce leaves, torn into irregular pieces about 3-6 cm, lightly coated with creamy pale dressing and scattered grated pale cheese shreds, sitting on the left-center of the plate | 70
ITEM 2 | Toasted bread croutons, golden-brown cubes about 1.5-2 cm with crisp, slightly porous surfaces, scattered among the lettuce | 25
ITEM 3 | Creamy pale dressing with grated pale cheese flakes, thin white sheen coating the lettuce leaves | 15
ITEM 4 | Bright yellow fruit wedges, firm and smooth-skinned, about 3-4 cm long and 1 cm thick, with pale flesh edges, one piece beside a lime-green wedge | 40
ITEM 5 | Pale green lime or citrus wedges with a bright green rind and pale flesh, about 3 cm across, one wedge partly under the yellow pieces | 15
ITEM 6 | Dark green leafy garnish, glossy, flat leaves about 4-5 cm, tucked between the fruit and the meat | 10
ITEM 7 | Sliced cooked meat, brown-pink with seared darker edges and fibrous grain, in thin strips about 1 cm thick and 6-8 cm long, lying across the right side of the plate, slightly moist | 90
ITEM 8 | Pale cubes of cooked chicken or similar light meat, golden-tan surface, about 2 cm pieces, firm and slightly browned, near the top center | 20
ITEM 9 | Yellow grain side, fluffy bright-yellow granular couscous-like grains with small dark specks (herbs or spice), loose and dry, mounded on the right side about 8 cm across and 1.5 cm high | 110
